_: Expected numbers of the whole-board bench `python -m Tools.KiCadDesignTools.regress --board demo` (templates/demo_board built from its data in out/regress/). Counts and texts exact, lengths to 0.005 mm. Taken from the template's build of 2026-11-24 (H4b). drc: the final DRC of the finish step by type (silk_over_copper: the 0402 / 0805 footprints' own silkscreen lines over tracks and vias, removed from the Gerbers by the solder mask); parity: schematic parity by type (net2pcb does not copy the symbols' fields; TP1's exclude-from-BOM flag differs from its symbol's), the same classes as on the H743 board.
